content: Walk-forward validation (rolling-origin) is the standard no-lookahead backtest method for time series: sklearn.model_selection.TimeSeriesSplit(n_splits, test_size, gap) implements an expanding-window walk-forward split out of the box (each fold's train set is a superset of prior folds' train set, test fold always strictly after train fold). This directly satisfies PRED-04's no-lookahead-bias requirement and works uniformly across SMA/XGBoost/Prophet since it only returns row-index splits, not model-specific objects.
